headline.zh: OpenAI 解密 GPT-Live：六個月打造無輪替低延遲語音系統
headline.en: OpenAI reveals GPT-Live continuous voice system architecture

detail.zh: OpenAI 分享如何透過無輪替（Turnless）語音模型與低延遲架構建置 GPT-Live。開發者現在可更清晰了解其即時語音 API 的底層設計，有助於優化雙向實時語音應用的數據串流與狀態處理。
detail.en: OpenAI detailed its engineering approach for GPT-Live, leveraging a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture. This provides developers with deeper insights into optimizing real-time voice API integration and streaming workflows.

headline.zh: 阿里巴巴推出 Qwen3.8-Max，宣稱性能直逼美系頂級模型
headline.en: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Max, rivaling top US frontier models

detail.zh: 阿里巴巴發布最新開放權重模型 Qwen3.8-Max，宣稱在多項基準測試中表現媲美 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的旗艦模型。該模型大幅提升了複雜推理能力，為私有化部署團隊提供強大的開源選擇。
detail.en: Alibaba has released Qwen3.8-Max, its most capable open-weight model to date, claiming performance that rivals top systems from Anthropic and OpenAI. It offers open-source deployers a competitive alternative for high-reasoning workloads.

headline.zh: 假漏洞真洗版？LLM 產生的「虛假 CVE」引發 SQLite 開源維護者反彈
headline.en: LLM-generated fake CVEs flood SQLite, triggering developer outcry

detail.zh: JFrog 研究指出，大量由 AI 產生的垃圾漏洞報告（LLM Slop）正在湧入 SQLite 等核心開源專案，造成開發團隊巨大的審查負擔。這凸顯了自動化 AI 工具缺乏驗證時，對開源生態系造成的嚴重認知負擔。
detail.en: JFrog highlighted a growing wave of hallucinated security reports generated by LLMs hitting open-source maintainers like SQLite. The trend underscores how unverified AI vulnerability scanners create significant cognitive debt for maintainers.

headline.zh: AirLLM 實現單張 4GB 顯存 GPU 執行 70B 模型推理
headline.en: AirLLM enables 70B model inference on a single 4GB GPU

detail.zh: AirLLM 透過分層載入（Layer-wise loading）技術，讓開發者能在消費級硬體甚至舊款 GPU 上執行 70B 參數等級的大模型。這大幅降低了本地微調與推理實驗的硬體門檻。
detail.en: AirLLM uses layer-wise loading memory optimization to run inference on 70B models using a single 4GB VRAM GPU, dramatically lowering the hardware barrier for running large models locally.

headline.zh: Nightcrawler：可在手機端執行的本地 AI 滲透測試 Agent
headline.en: Nightcrawler: Local AI pentesting agent running on smartphones

detail.zh: 開源專案 Nightcrawler 支援完全在智慧型手機本地執行自動化網路滲透測試。這展現了邊緣端 Agent 的強大潛力，提供資安工程師無需依賴雲端 API 的離線測試選擇。
detail.en: Nightcrawler is an open-source security agent designed to run penetration testing locally on mobile devices. It showcases edge AI capabilities without requiring cloud API connections.

headline.zh: condense-json 1.0 發布：降低 LLM Prompt 數值的 JSON 壓縮工具
headline.en: condense-json 1.0 released to compress JSON for LLM prompts

detail.zh: Simon Willison 發布 condense-json 1.0，專為將結構化 JSON 輸入 LLM 時進行壓縮。該工具可顯著減少提示詞 Token 消耗，進而降低 API 費用並提高 Context 空間利用率。
detail.en: Simon Willison released condense-json 1.0, a utility built to strip redundancy from JSON payloads before feeding them into LLM prompts, effectively reducing token usage and API costs.

headline.zh: AWS 支援 Superblocks 私有雲部署，Vibe-Coding 正式走入企業級架構
headline.en: AWS supports Superblocks in private clouds for enterprise vibe-coding

detail.zh: AWS 允許 Vibe-Coding 工具 Superblocks 直接嵌入客戶的 AWS 私有雲中。這意味著企業可以在確保敏感資料不外洩的前提下，使用 AI 快速生成內部應用程式與自動化工作流。
detail.en: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded directly into customers' private clouds, enabling enterprise teams to auto-generate internal tools while adhering to strict cloud security constraints.

headline.zh: AI 監考系統嚴重出錯，導致 5.8 萬名學生被迫重考
headline.en: AI-supervised remote exam failure forces 58,000 students to retake test

detail.zh: 一場由 AI 監考的遠距考試出現大規模判讀異常，高分人數暴增 5 倍，導致 5.8 萬名考生必須重新應試。此事件再次暴露了自動化 AI 評估機制在缺乏人工複核時的巨大隱患。
detail.en: A national remote exam supervised by AI experienced critical failures, causing high scores to jump fivefold and forcing 58,000 students to retake it. The incident highlights the risks of unmonitored AI proctoring systems.

headline.zh: 研究顯示 AI 將 COBOL 舊系統遷移至 Java 時會忠實保留原始 Bug
headline.en: Research reveals AI preserves original bugs when migrating COBOL to Java

detail.zh: arXiv 最新論文指出，利用 LLM 自動將 Legacy COBOL 轉換為 Java 雖然速度快，但模型傾向於原封不動地複製原本的邏輯缺陷。開發者在進行跨語言重構時，仍需補足單元測試與安全審查。
detail.en: An arXiv paper shows that while LLMs excel at translating legacy COBOL programs to Java, they faithfully reproduce existing software bugs in the target code, emphasizing the need for comprehensive post-migration testing.

headline.zh: 美商 AI 技術升級烏克蘭自殺無人機，實現邊緣端自主目標追蹤
headline.en: US AI enables autonomous target tracking for Ukrainian kamikaze drones

detail.zh: 烏克蘭獲得美國 AI 廠商提供的邊緣辨識演算法，讓成本極低廉的無人機能在面對強烈電磁干擾時，自主識別並追蹤目標，展現了輕量化視覺模型在無網路環境的落地應用。
detail.en: A $100M deal equips 50,000 Ukrainian low-cost drones with US-developed AI algorithms, allowing them to autonomously track targets on the edge even when jammed, demonstrating offline computer vision resilience.

headline.zh: 歐盟 AI 法案透明度條款正式生效，強制標示 Chatbot 與 Deepfake
headline.en: EU AI Act transparency rules take effect, enforcing mandatory AI labels

detail.zh: 自 8 月 2 日起，歐盟 AI 法案中的透明度規範全面實施，要求所有在歐盟運營的產品必須明確告知使用者是否正在與 AI 模型互動，且生成的合成影音內容必須具備可辨識標籤。
detail.en: New transparency obligations under the EU AI Act are now active as of August 2nd, mandating clear disclosures when users interact with chatbots and requiring explicit labels or watermarks on AI-generated deepfakes.

headline.zh: 雲端巨頭隱性 AI 債務達 1.65 兆美元，硬體融資風險引關注
headline.en: Hidden AI borrowing hits $1.65T as hyperscaler capex continues to explode

detail.zh: 最新分析指出，科技巨頭為了採購 GPU 與擴建 AI 資料中心，透過複雜的租賃與發債架構累積了高達 1.65 兆美元的隱性債務。若 AI 軟體變現速度不及資本支出成長，可能面臨財務風險。
detail.en: Hyperscalers have accumulated up to $1.65 trillion in off-balance-sheet debt and leasing structures to fund AI infrastructure, raising warnings over financial risk if enterprise AI revenues lag behind capex.

headline.zh: 工程師主張手動重打 LLM 生成的程式碼，以保持程式庫掌控度並減少認知債
headline.en: Developer suggests manually retyping LLM code to maintain code comprehension and reduce cognitive debt

headline.zh: David Crawshaw 分享每日 Cron 提示詞：讓 Coding Agent 自動拉取並 Rebase 上游程式碼
headline.en: David Crawshaw shares a daily cron prompt that leverages coding agents to fetch and rebase upstream changes automatically

headline.zh: 專注於為前沿模型導入人類設計審美的評測平台 Design Arena 獲 790 萬美元融資
headline.en: Design Arena team raises $7.9M to bring human design evaluation and taste to frontier AI models

headline.zh: 財務記錄顯示 ChatGPT 為美國國會使用率最高的付費 AI 工具，用於起草備忘錄與法案摘要
headline.en: House spending records reveal ChatGPT as Congress's top paid AI tool for drafting memos and legislation
